description: This file defines the Permission entity class used within the user administration domain of the Apache Fineract project. It models permissions with attributes such as groupings, codes, entity and action names, and maker-checker capabilities, providing methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Entity class representing a system permission, including properties for grouping, code, associated entity and action names, and maker-checker flag.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Permission object with specified grouping, entityName, actionName, and default canMakerChecker to false.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Protected default constructor for JPA and serialization purposes, initializing fields to null or false.

methods.name: hasCode
methods.description: Checks if the permission's code matches the provided checkCode (case-insensitive).

methods.name: hasMakerCheckerEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether maker-checker is enabled for this permission.

methods.name: getGrouping
methods.description: Returns the grouping attribute of the permission.

methods.name: enableMakerChecker
methods.description: Enables or disables the maker-checker feature and returns true if the value was changed.
